info.description: Run each entire folder, one iteration, delay 1000 ms, request timeout 20000 ms. Development only. Default Events requires RabbitMQ on Trip/Matching/Payment. See docs/postman-demo.md. Failure folders intentionally leave unresolved PaymentPending trips. Mock only; no real card data.
